title: Blood Tendency
subtitle: What the blood remembers killing
text: Blood Tendency is the elemental alignment of your blood, shaped by what you have killed and consumed over time. There are eight tendencies: Vivacious, Fervent, Frigid, Ruinous, Incandescent, Umbral, Neurotic, and Ferric. The infection's dormant memories are keyed to these alignments — certain powers can only be drawn out by blood that has absorbed the right kind of violence. The tendency you carry is a record of what you are. The blood does not forget.
